notes.title: Update Ver.0.5.4
notes.notes:
Updated to Ver.0.5.4.
Fixed a bug where “Hot-Blooded Headbutt” and “Reactive Magic” would not trigger under certain conditions

Fixed a bug where “Substitute” was not removed after specific attacks

Adjusted so guaranteed-hit skills can also be redirected by some enemies’ "Protect" skill

Increased the power of "Hot-Blooded Headbutt" and "Reactive Magic" from "Small" to "Medium"

Adjusted cooldown times for the following skills to be shorter:

"Focus", "Tuning", "Harden", "Coating", "Wing Flap", "Battle Cry", "Armor of Dust"

Buffs and debuffs (e.g. “STR↑”, “Accuracy↓”) can now stack up to 2 levels

Added visual effects when “Hot-Blooded Headbutt” and “Reactive Magic” trigger

Added new Artifacts:

“Stamp Card”, “Headband”, “Hand Mirror"

Added new dialogue patterns when helping villagers

Fixed various other text and bugs



We are currently implementing a library feature that will display skills, items, and TIPS in a list format.
I believe that adding a large number of new skills and items will be smoother after the library feature is in place, as it will make it easier to check the effects, so please bear with us for a little while.

From next month, we expect to increase the update frequency, so thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Update Ver.0.5.3
notes.notes:
Updated to Ver.0.5.3.
Fixed a bug where players were charged for ingredients they didn’t consume

Fixed an issue where the skill "IIndomitable Spirit" and the item "Dragon Plushie" could activate simultaneously
("Indomitable Spirit" will now take priority)

Added a process to prevent freezing when obtaining a number of artifacts close to the total available

Changed so that auto-save will not occur immediately after loading save data

Adjusted cooldown times for the following skills to be shorter:

"Charge", "Lock On", "Rage Charge", "Reckless Attack", "Heavy Impact", "Armor Break", "Magic Thorn", "Loud Shout", "High-Pressure Heat Ray", "Space Erosion", "Dragon's Rage", "Noise"

Increased the power of the skill “Death Roll” from "Large" to "Massive"

The skill "Curse" has been reclassified from Magical Attack to Special Attack
(Special Attack is a new category; more skills will be added under it in future updates)

Increased the effects of items: "Giant's Bracelet", "Wind Cutter Bracelet", and "Kaleidoscope"

Fixed various other text and bugs



Starting next month, we expect to gradually begin adding new skills and items.

We appreciate your continued support!

notes.title: Update Ver.0.5.2
notes.notes:
Updated to Ver.0.5.2.
Fixed a bug where an error would occur when selecting ingredients under certain conditions

Fixed a bug where already acquired passive skills would appear during skill selection

Fixed a bug where enemies could be re-randomized when retrying the "Small Calamity" battle

Fixed a bug where holding the Alt key would also skip messages instead of only the Ctrl key

Changed it so that when using the skills "Heat Exhaust" and "Mindfulness," those skills themselves are no longer affected by their own effects

Adjusted the effects of several items and skills (mainly adjusting effects and cooldowns of items that were too convenient on their own)

Adjusted the effect amount and price of the artifact "Deadly Poison"

Adjusted the price of the artifact "Dice Bento"

Adjusted the cooldown of the skill "Poison Claw"

Adjusted the cooldown of the skills "Heat Exhaust" and "Mindfulness"

Adjusted the cooldown of the skill "Poison Rush"

Adjusted the cooldown of the skill "Venomous Fang"

Adjusted the effect amount of the skill "Earth Stance"

Adjusted the duration (turns) of the skill "High-Speed Flight"

Fixed various other text and bugs

notes.title: Update Ver.0.5.1
notes.notes:
Updated to Ver.0.5.1.
Fixed a critical bug where the game could reset when doing training camp while the language was set to English.

Fixed a bug where certain graphics would display incorrectly under high FPS environments.

Fixed an issue where the help message would not display under certain conditions when selecting a villager with max affinity

Fixed a bug where "Breath" would disappear from the skill list after certain random events

Fixed a bug where upgrades for unequipped skills were sometimes not selected

Adjusted the processing of the item "Bloody Raw Meat"

Fixed a bug where the skills "Adrenaline" and "Analysis" could overwrite the next action depending on activation timing (activation timing is now set to the end of the turn when evasion occurs)

Fixed a bug where the skill "Star Scale" would not activate first
